entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 130:2
segments: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: But [there is] forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

words.text: with thee, that thou mayest be feared

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: ¶I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: [I say, more than] they that watch for the morning. {I say...: or, which watch unto}

words.text: : [I say, more than] they that watch

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD [there is] mercy, and with him [is] plenteous redemption.

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
